title: Wavelength-Uniform Quantum Algorithms for Mixed-State Quantum Dynamics
summary: One of the main challenges in numerical simulation of quantum dynamics is the prohibitive cost in the semi-classical regime, in which the de Broglie wave length is small compared with the characteristic length scale and the solution is highly oscillatory. For the von-Neumann equation for mixed-state quantum dynamics, this difficulty is overcome by using the Weyl variables, under which the solution is not oscillatory.
